c1-03-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Does the Claim Come From?
c1-03-01.scenario: A colleague asks how sure you are that the decision was made early.
c1-03-01.prompt: Tell your colleague what the contemporary documents say about the decision.
cues: Say when the decision was made
c1-03-01.target: A korabeli dokumentumok tanúsága szerint a döntést már hónapokkal korábban meghozták.
c1-03-01.english: According to the contemporary documents, the decision had been made months earlier.
c1-03-01.canDo: I can say whether a claim comes from a witness or from hearsay.

c1-03-02.title: Communicative Challenge: How Likely Is It?
c1-03-02.scenario: A reviewer asks if the negotiations will end quickly.
c1-03-02.prompt: Tell the reviewer that you think it is very unlikely.
cues: Say what you expect to end quickly
c1-03-02.target: Aligha hihető, hogy a tárgyalások gyorsan véget érnek.
c1-03-02.english: It is hardly believable that the negotiations will end quickly.
c1-03-02.canDo: I can say how likely something is, from almost certain to hardly possible.

c1-03-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Leaving the Door Open
c1-03-03.scenario: A tutor asks if future discoveries might change your view.
c1-03-03.prompt: Tell the tutor that this cannot be excluded.
cues: Say it cannot be ruled out
c1-03-03.target: Nem zárható ki, hogy a jövőbeli felfedezések megváltoztatják az álláspontunkat.
c1-03-03.english: It cannot be ruled out that future discoveries will change our standpoint.
c1-03-03.canDo: I can say that something cannot be ruled out with nem zárható ki, hogy.

c1-03-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Appearance and Reality
c1-03-04.scenario: A reviewer asks about a surprising result in your research.
c1-03-04.prompt: Tell the reviewer how the result looks and what it really is.
cues: Say what is really going on
c1-03-04.target: A jelenség látszólag nem követi a fizika törvényeit, ám valójában ritka kölcsönhatásról van szó.
c1-03-04.english: The phenomenon seemingly does not follow the laws of physics, but in reality it is a rare interaction.
c1-03-04.canDo: I can qualify a statement with némiképp, némileg, látszólag or mindeddig.

c1-03-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Humble Scholar
c1-03-05.scenario: After reading the text about Szerb Antal, a classmate asks what the text says about scholars.
c1-03-05.prompt: Tell your classmate what the text says is the danger for a historian.
cues: Say what the text recommends instead
c1-03-05.target: A szöveg szerint a történész legnagyobb kísértése a gőg, ezért inkább óvatosan közelít a forrásokhoz.
c1-03-05.english: According to the text, the historian's greatest temptation is pride, so he approaches the sources with care.
c1-03-05.canDo: I can follow a short text about Szerb Antal's scholarly humility.

c1-03-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Careful Conclusion
c1-03-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a seminar, the tutor asks for your conclusion about a manuscript.
c1-03-consolidation.prompt: Give a careful conclusion: the source, the probability and a reservation.
cues: Say how likely the result is
c1-03-consolidation.target: A források tanúsága szerint a kézirat minden bizonnyal régi, de nem zárható ki, hogy később másolták.
c1-03-consolidation.english: According to the sources the manuscript is in all probability old, but it cannot be ruled out that it was copied later.
c1-03-consolidation.canDo: I can mark where a claim comes from and how reliable it is.
